propositions: git blame file-level auto-derivation for caused_by edges shows 50% abstention rate and only 43% agreement with recorded targets in the population of 88 closed bugs with caused_by edges
on the subsample of 8 bugs with independently proven origins, the deriver reproduced zero correct attributions and named the wrong target in the one confident output (moist-short-lionfish case)
caused_by edges carry no provenance marker distinguishing blame-derived from explicitly supplied origins, making it impossible to weight or exclude guesses

the dominant defect shapes in this codebase (unmet obligations, carrier commits, omissions) are structurally hard for file-level blame and mostly result in deriver abstention rather than misattribution

decision required: add a derived:blame|explicit marker to caused_by link events to enable metrics to discount guesses; a shape-aware deriver change is not implementable since shape is not observable to the blame mechanism itself
